artifact_identity_recomputed.note: Every source, model, DMG and installed-bundle identity is re-derived from disk in evidence/recheck_artifacts.json; a mismatch fails this gate.

build_and_package.note: gatekeeper_assessed only records that a local, non-notarized RC is rejected by Gatekeeper; it is an environment constraint, not a build failure.

experiment_non_interference.note: Raw pre/post over the whole evidence window is reported unchanged: 1 real-root write, on ~/.simigo/.DS_Store. That file is a Finder view-metadata container (verified by its Bud1 header at verify time, not by assertion), it was rewritten at 01:30:44 - inside a window with no candidate process alive - and a bracket pair taken immediately around one launch of the same installed binary reports 0 writes. Every product state path (sqlite3, -wal, -shm, prefix-pool, branch-checkpoints, manifests, Application Support, HF reference root) is unmodified. evidence/noninterference_residual_analysis.md holds the full attribution and the re-test condition; nothing was allowlisted to reach this verdict.

install_and_operate.note: The installed, independently path'd app resolves the three isolated roots, completes bootstrap (20 models, schema v3, 0 issues), creates its sqlite database, quits and restarts from the same bundle. Two blockers used to hide this: (1) round 3 found Service.init() blocking forever inside SecItemCopyMatching because CloudKeychain read the real login Keychain and the item's ACL answered the new binary with an interactive SecurityAgent prompt (securityd: 'QueryKeychainUse::queryUser'); that isolation gap is fixed in this build - CloudKeychain is inert when SIMIGO_HOME is set - and is covered by testIsolatedManagedRootNeverReadsOrWritesTheLoginKeychain. (2) The user-visible prompt leg is still unproven: this host grants the driver no Screen Recording, so although the 8 GUI attempts now reach the AX tree (2 menu bars, 6 items) and AXPress succeeds, no window appears, screencapture fails ('could not create image from display') and no keystroke can be typed into a prompt field. An unproven leg stays BLOCKED rather than being inferred from stage A.

keychain_non_interference.note: Round 2 found every headless run creating a one-time LOCALB transport identity in the real login Keychain (45 items: 3 per process, index + key + certificate), because SIMIGO_HOME redirected every filesystem root but not the Keychain. Round 3 fixes the product, not the measurement: LOCALBTransportIdentityStore resolves its identity into <SIMIGO_HOME>/localb/transport-identity.keychain-db whenever the managed root is isolated, and scopes every SecItem call (kSecUseKeychain for adds, kSecMatchSearchList for copy/update/delete, SecIdentityCreateWithCertificate(keychain) for the TLS identity). The audit is now a metadata delta against a baseline captured before the runs; the 45 round-1/2 items are left in place as evidence rather than deleted. Production credentials (com.simigo.localb-*) are untouched. Round 4 adds the second half of the same isolation rule: CloudKeychain (service SimiGo, cloud.api-key) is inert while SIMIGO_HOME is set, because an isolated run that reads the real credential both blocks Service.init() behind an ACL prompt and pulls a user secret into the candidate's window.

per_layer_forward_calls.note: No per-layer forward-count instrumentation exists in the product.

physical_page_return.note: No OS-level page-return evidence was collected; footprint/exit is supporting only.

product_service_http.note: Round 2 reached the installed app's real HTTPServer (ephemeral port observed via lsof on the running pid, TLS-only: plaintext gets an empty reply) and its authorized lane is refused exactly as designed: a POST carrying a fabricated LOCALB proof returns 503 'LOCALB request authorization is not configured' because this build ships no surface that performs the activation ceremony (app_target_call_sites=0 in evidence/localb_authorization_path.txt), so the guard fires before any proof is evaluated. The same product code does serve authorized requests once activated - proven by the product's own tests in the round-2 test binary. Closing this gate needs a shipped activation surface, not a weakened guard.

resource_lifecycle.note: Round 2: the Release binary has no idle-timing seam, so the probe waits out the production adaptive idle floor (240 s) and then calls the unmodified suspendIfIdle(); every observed value below comes from that path. A FAIL here means the shipped suspend/reclaim path did not actually take effect.
